name: Marketing Cloud Next Consultant
notes: 116 preguntas transcritas de un banco de práctica (dos tandas). Cuatro preguntas del original estaban cortadas por saltos de página y no se pudieron recuperar.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters wants to configure its SMS channel so that when a customer replies to a promotional text with a custom question, the interaction is automatically handed off to an AI agent for ongoing support. Which configuration should a Marketing Cloud Next Consultant implement to handle this inbound response?
o: Omni-Channel flow to route the inbound Messaging Session to the AI agent
Record-triggered flow on the Messaging Session object to route the session to the AI agent
Assignment rule on the Messaging Session object to route the session to the AI agent
questions.e: Las respuestas entrantes generan una Messaging Session y el enrutamiento de esa sesión hacia un agente se hace con un flujo de Omni-Channel, no con reglas de asignación ni flujos record-triggered.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters (NTO) has customers who opted in to its "Promotions" email subscription but later opted out. NTO is concerned its "Product Updates" emails will also stop sending to those customers. What should the Marketing Cloud Next Consultant do to address this concern?
o: Advise NTO that its "Product Updates" emails will continue sending, since Marketing Cloud Next manages consent at the communication subscription level and an opt-out on one subscription does not affect other subscriptions.

Advise NTO to import a new subscription file related to the "Product Updates" subscription, since an opt-out in Marketing Cloud Next is applied globally across all subscriptions for that email address.
Advise NTO to set up an automated re-opt-in campaign targeting opted-out customers, since Marketing Cloud Next requires an active OPT_IN record to be refreshed every 90 days to remain valid.
questions.e: En Marketing Cloud Next el consentimiento se gestiona por Communication Subscription (y canal): darse de baja de una suscripción no afecta a las demás.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters (NTO) wants to set up distinct marketing channels for its North American and European operations. Each region has separate regulatory requirements and branding guidelines. The Marketing Cloud Next Consultant must ensure that marketing activities and assets are completely segregated between the two regions. Which initial step must the consultant take in the Marketing Cloud Next setup?
o: Implement two distinct Data Spaces in Data 360.
Configure a separate Business Unit for each region.
Establish a unique CMS Workspace for each region.
questions.e: El aislamiento total de datos, activos y normativa entre regiones se consigue separando Data Spaces en Data 360; la BU separa usuarios/marca pero no los datos.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters (NTO) is confused about why its newly imported data is not immediately available and why identity resolution does not update instantly. NTO's identity resolution follows the default automated schedule. What should the Marketing Cloud Next Consultant explain about the timing of data syncs and identity resolution?
o: Most new data syncs about every 10 minutes, but identity resolution runs only once per day.
New data syncs once per day, and identity resolution runs about every 10 minutes.
All data syncs instantly, but identity resolution runs only once per week.
questions.e: Comportamiento por defecto: la mayoría de sincronizaciones de datos ocurren cada ~10 minutos, mientras que la identity resolution se ejecuta una vez al día.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters has enabled Email Engagement Scoring in Marketing Cloud Next to generate predictions for email opens, clicks, and unsubscribes. Which data model object (DMO) stores these predictive engagement scores for reporting and segmentation?
o: Email Engagement Metrics
Email Engagement Profile
Email Engagement Score
questions.e: El DMO Email Engagement Score almacena las puntuaciones predictivas de apertura, clic y baja para reporting y segmentación.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters (NTO) wants to include a Last_Purchased_Date field from a Data Graph in a new marketing email. The date/time value is displayed as 2027-03-15T08:30:45 when previewing the email. NTO wants it to display as: Monday, March 15, 2027 8:30 AM. Which approach should NTO use?
o: Use a Handlebars helper to format the value.
Use an SOQL function to transform the value.
Use a Salesforce formula operator to format the value.
questions.e: El formateo de fechas dentro de plantillas se hace con helpers de Handlebars; SOQL y las fórmulas de Salesforce no actúan en el renderizado del email.

questions.q: Which permission sets are required for a System Administrator to perform basic setup?
o: Data 360 Architect and Marketing Cloud Admin
Data 360 Architect and Marketing Cloud Manager
Data 360 Activation Manager and Marketing Cloud Admin
questions.e: El setup básico requiere Data 360 Architect (modelo de datos) + Marketing Cloud Admin (configuración de marketing).

questions.q: A Marketing Cloud Next Consultant observes a spike in Data Services Credits usage in Digital Wallet. The consultant already optimized the number of rows processed by Identity Resolution. Which other method should the consultant use to reduce credit consumption?
o: Disable "Run jobs automatically" on the identity resolution rule(s).
Maintain multiple active rulesets per primary Data Model Object (DMO) per data space.
Delete and recreate data streams to remove unused records.
questions.e: Desactivar la ejecución automática de los jobs de identity resolution evita ejecuciones innecesarias y reduce el consumo de Data Services Credits.

questions.q: A Marketing Cloud Next Consultant wants to use marketing agents to automate the generation of a new campaign, draft email content, and build an audience segment in the company's account. What is the best workflow for the consultant to use?
o: Use the Campaign Creation Agent to generate the campaign record, content, and audience criteria, and then use audience criteria in Segment Creation to build the segment.
Use a custom agent configured with custom Prompt Builder and Data 360 actions to generate the campaign record, build the segment, and draft the content using a single prompt.
Use the Campaign Agent to natively build the segment, draft the content, and generate the campaign record using a single prompt.
questions.e: El Campaign Creation Agent genera campaña, contenido y criterios de audiencia; esos criterios se reutilizan luego en Segment Creation para crear el segmento.

questions.q: A financial services company is launching a Conversational Email campaign. The goal is to give customers the ability to reply directly to outbound promotional emails to initiate a real-time interaction with an AI agent. The Marketing Cloud Next Consultant has already built the required flow to handle the inbound routing. What is the required configuration step to ensure customer replies are successfully captured for response handling?
o: Configure Reply Mail Management (RMM) and set it to forward inbound replies to the AI agent's queue.
Configure the sending From Address's Agent Conversational Messaging and set the Routing Type to send inbound replies.
Configure the Route Work activity to successfully connect to the next flow to generate an email response.
questions.e: Conversational Email se habilita en la From Address: se configura Agent Conversational Messaging y el Routing Type para capturar las respuestas entrantes.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters wants to create a segment to find all individuals who have made at least one purchase. Purchase data is stored in a related data model object (DMO) that can have multiple records for a single individual. Which two concepts should a Marketing Cloud Next Consultant use in the segment builder to correctly evaluate this condition?
o: Aggregations and Container Paths
Publish Type and Aggregations
Container Paths and Publish Type
questions.e: Para evaluar condiciones sobre DMOs relacionados con varios registros por individuo se usan Aggregations (al menos una compra) y Container Paths (ruta al objeto relacionado).

questions.q: A Marketing Cloud Next Consultant wants to build a messaging flow that delivers a notification to everyone that has active consent in SMS or Email. The notification must only be sent via one channel using the following logic: • If the customer is opted in to both channels, the flow must route to their preferred channel. • If they are opted out of their preferred channel, it must route to the alternative channel. Which flow element and configuration should the consultant select to handle this routing?
o: Add a Decision element with multiple configured outcomes.
Add several nested Decision elements.
Add an Omni-Channel Routing action.
questions.e: Un único elemento Decision admite varios outcomes con condiciones ordenadas; es la forma limpia de resolver la lógica de canal preferido/alternativo.

questions.q: A healthcare company has very specific requirements for data sharing and privacy. Which scenario requires the healthcare company to add a Business Unit to ensure compliance?
o: The company requires distinct subscriptions, branding, and authenticated sender domains for general messaging like newsletters, compared to appointment reminder and other transactional-based messaging.

The company must ensure that general marketing users can view standard contact information, but are completely restricted from viewing or querying custom health-related data fields on the Contact record.

The company manages multiple subsidiary clinics and requires strict isolation so that marketers for Clinic A cannot query, segment, or accidentally send campaigns to the profiles belonging to Clinic B.
questions.e: La BU añade aislamiento de visibilidad de datos entre equipos: el caso que lo exige es impedir que marketers de una clínica vean o segmenten perfiles de otra.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters is creating a ongoing promotional email campaign targeting its entire global audience. Which feature should a Marketing Cloud Next Consultant suggest to maximize individual engagement by achieving higher inbox placement?
o: Send Time Optimization
Engagement Frequency
Engagement Scoring
questions.e: Send Time Optimization envía a cada individuo en su momento óptimo, lo que mejora el engagement y la colocación en bandeja de entrada.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters needs to prevent sending duplicate messages to individuals who have multiple email addresses stored in Data 360. A Marketing Cloud Next Consultant is building an audience flow and must ensure that only one specific email address is used for each individual. Which feature should the consultant use to define the logic for selecting a single, appropriate email address for the message send?
o: Create and apply a Contact Point Selection Rule in an activation template.
Configure a Salesforce Flow Decision element to query for the primary email.
Implement an identity resolution ruleset to merge duplicate contact points.
questions.e: Las Contact Point Selection Rules dentro de una plantilla de activación definen qué contact point único se usa por individuo.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters wants to create a campaign targeting prospects. However, a marketer discovers that prospect records cannot be added as campaign members. How should a Marketing Cloud Next Consultant explain this behavior?
o: Prospects must be represented as a lead or contact.
Prospects can only be added as campaign members using an audience flow.
Prospects can be added as campaign members only after the campaign has been set to active.
questions.e: Los prospects no son miembros de campaña válidos: deben existir como lead o contact para poder añadirse como campaign members.

questions.q: A company is evaluating which Salesforce features require Marketing Cloud Next Advanced Edition versus the Growth Edition. The implementation team has a list of features they plan to use. Which feature from their list mandates the use of Advanced Edition?
o: Creating account identity resolution rulesets
Creating standard Salesforce reports and dashboards
Creating content in the content builder
questions.e: Los rulesets de identity resolution a nivel de account (B2B) requieren Advanced Edition; reports y Content Builder están en Growth.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters wants customers to reply directly to order notification emails with any questions. Customer replies must be analyzed for intent and routed to an agent or a human representative while preserving the context of the interaction. Which solution should a Marketing Cloud Next Consultant recommend?
o: Configure Reply Mail Management with Agentforce 360 to analyze replies and create cases for human escalations.
Configure Conversational Email with Agentforce 360 and Digital Engagement to analyze and route customer replies.
Use Engagement Scoring to analyze replies, then route using an automation event-triggered flow.
questions.e: Conversational Email con Agentforce 360 + Digital Engagement analiza la intención de la respuesta y enruta a agente o humano conservando el contexto.

questions.q: A Marketing Cloud Next Consultant wants to build an audience flow to send a promotional email series. To prevent a poor customer experience, the flow must suppress each email for any customer who currently has an open support case. Which flow elements and logic should the consultant configure to solve this suppression?
o: Add a Get Records element to query the Case object followed by a Decision element to correctly route eligible records.
Add an Exclusion Filter element and configure the criteria to drop records where the related Case status is open.
Add a Decision element and configure a cross-object formula within the criteria to evaluate the related Case status directly.
questions.e: No existe elemento de exclusión ni fórmulas cross-object en criterios: se consulta Case con Get Records y se decide con un elemento Decision.

questions.q: A Marketing Cloud Next Consultant is designing a flow that uses the Send to Journey element. The business requires that the journey uses a specific contact point derived from an activation template. Which configuration is a prerequisite for this solution to function correctly?
o: The flow's Data Space must link to the journey's Business Unit.
The journey must use a Salesforce Data Entry Source.
The flow must be a record-triggered flow.
questions.e: El Send to Journey exige que el Data Space del flujo esté vinculado a la Business Unit del journey para resolver contact points.

questions.q: Employees at an online retailer want to use AI to gain insights into existing business accounts and identify buyer group members to nurture. Which Marketing Cloud Next Agent should they deploy?
o: Agentforce Employee
Account Discovery
Segment Creation
questions.e: El agente Account Discovery analiza cuentas existentes e identifica miembros del buying group a cultivar.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters needs to personalize an email content block using data from related objects defined in Data 360. The personalization must reflect attributes tied to Unified Individuals. Which data source type should a Marketing Cloud Next Consultant use to access this related data for personalization?
o: Data Graph
Personalization Recommender
Unified Individual Data Model Object (DMO)
questions.e: El Data Graph precalcula y aplana los datos relacionados del Unified Individual, que es lo que consume la personalización.

questions.q: A Marketing Cloud Next Consultant is implementing Marketing Cloud Next for a customer that currently stores all consent records in Salesforce CRM consent objects. The customer wants to understand how consent is managed in Marketing Cloud Next. What should the consultant explain about the relationship between the CRM consent model and the Marketing Cloud Next consent model?
o: The CRM consent objects are the source of truth for Marketing Cloud Next consent.
The CRM consent objects are automatically synchronized with the Marketing Cloud Next consent model when Marketing Cloud Next is activated.
The CRM consent model and the Marketing Cloud Next consent model are completely separate, and a custom process is required to keep them in sync.
questions.e: Los modelos de consentimiento de CRM y de Marketing Cloud Next son independientes; sincronizarlos requiere un proceso personalizado.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters wants customer service reps to be able to view and update a customer's communication consent preferences directly from the customer's CRM record when interacting with them in the contact center. Which component should a Marketing Cloud Next Consultant add to the Contact record page to enable this capability?
o: Privacy Consent Status
Data 360 Related Lists
Data 360 Profile Insights
questions.e: El componente Privacy Consent Status permite ver y actualizar las preferencias de consentimiento desde el registro de Contact.

questions.q: A Marketing Cloud Next Consultant is preparing to send emails using an authenticated custom domain. After adding the domain in the Authenticated Domains setup page, Marketing Cloud Next generates the required DNS records. Which action must the consultant perform next to complete the domain authentication process?
o: Upload the generated TXT record to their domain's DNS provider.
Add the generated CNAME and DKIM records to their domain's DNS provider.
Create a new Sender Authentication Package within Marketing Cloud Next.
questions.e: Tras añadir el dominio autenticado hay que publicar los registros CNAME y DKIM generados en el proveedor DNS del cliente.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters (NTO) wants to send a confirmation email immediately after a prospect submits a form on a landing page published in Marketing Cloud Next. NTO wants to personalize the email using the values entered in the submitted form. Which data source should NTO use when configuring the email?
o: Event Data Provider
Activation Data Provider
Data Graph Data Provider
questions.e: Los valores enviados en un formulario llegan como evento en tiempo real: se usa el Event Data Provider para personalizar el email de confirmación.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters wants to automatically send a promotional email to new CRM Contacts using Marketing Cloud Next. Before the email can be sent, what should the Marketing Cloud Next Consultant configure to ensure a new contact is eligible to receive promotional communications?
o: Create a consent record in the Communication Subscription Consent CRM object.
Use the Create Consent Flow element to set a consent status for the contact point.
Set the Has Opted Out of Email field on the Contact record to False.
questions.e: El envío promocional exige un registro de consentimiento OPT_IN en el objeto CRM Communication Subscription Consent antes de poder enviar.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters (NTO) uses a calculated insight in Data 360 to evaluate a 'Churn Risk' status. NTO's Marketing Cloud Next Consultant must automate a re-engagement email to send within 24 hours of when a customer becomes high risk. Which flow type and configuration should the consultant use?
o: Build a segment using the calculated insight as a criteria and configure an audience flow to send the email.
Build a Data 360-triggered flow on the Calculated Insights Object with the entry condition set to trigger when the status changes.
Build a record-triggered flow on the Calculated Insights Object with a changed status entry condition to send the email.
questions.e: Se construye un segmento con el calculated insight como criterio y se envía con un audience flow; no existe un trigger directo sobre Calculated Insights.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters (NTO) is designing a monthly 'Trail Rewards' email in Marketing Cloud Next. NTO needs to dynamically personalize the template using two data points: • The number of 'Days Since Last Login' to nudge digital adoption • The customer's current 'Loyalty Tier' based on their lifetime spend to apply the correct branding. To minimize Flex Credit consumption within their Digital Wallet, how should a Marketing Cloud Next Consultant configure the template?
o: Data stream formula for login days and Daily Batch calculated insight for the loyalty tier
Streaming insight for login days and a data stream formula for the loyalty tier
Daily Batch calculated insight for login days and a streaming insight for the loyalty tier
questions.e: Las fórmulas de data stream son mucho más baratas que los streaming insights; el batch diario basta para un tier de lealtad que cambia poco.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters (NTO) is investigating reports that promotional emails are being delivered to individuals who have previously opted out earlier the same day. NTO discovers that customer consent preferences are updated daily using a batch data transform that writes directly to the Communication Subscription Consent data model object (DMO) causing customer complaints. Which action should the Marketing Cloud Next Consultant take to resolve it?
o: Use a streaming data transform to update consent in near real time.
Configure a Create Consent action in a Data 360-triggered flow to update consent.
Change the frequency of the batch data transform schedule to run hourly.
questions.e: El consentimiento debe escribirse con la acción Create Consent desde un flujo Data 360-triggered, no por transformaciones batch que escriben directamente el DMO.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters wants to provide its marketing team with a deeper understanding of email campaign performance. The marketing manager needs to create a custom report that details unsubscribe reasons and failed send statuses, leveraging the unified data model. Which component should the Marketing Cloud Next Consultant use to build this detailed report?
o: The Marketing Insights for Agentforce Sales dashboard
A Lightning Report using the Marketing Performance Semantic Data Model
A custom report type based on the Campaign Member object
questions.e: El Marketing Performance Semantic Data Model expone motivos de baja y estados de envío para construir informes Lightning personalizados.

questions.q: A company stores localized promo codes within a custom marketing object. The company wants to dynamically populate the correct promo code into a newsletter based on the recipient's [Region_Code]. What is the most effective way to retrieve and render this data within the email?
o: Write an AMPscript LookupRows() block within the email to query the marketing object directly at send time using the [Region_Code]. Output the results directly into the email.
Use the Handlebars QueryFirst utility function inline to retrieve the promo code, so it prints natively on the canvas.
Insert standard merge fields utilizing cross-object dot notation ({{{Marketing_Object.Promo_Code__c}}}) to pull the value across using the Unified Individual ID.
questions.e: Handlebars QueryFirst recupera inline el registro del marketing object y lo imprime de forma nativa en el canvas (AMPscript no está soportado aquí).

questions.q: A Marketing Cloud Next Consultant wants to automate a weekly promotional email to a targeted audience of high-value customers identified within Data 360. Which flow type and configuration should the consultant select?
o: Build a schedule-triggered flow configured to run weekly and use a Get Records element to query the high-value customer data model object (DMO).
Build an audience flow using a Segment data source (the customer segment) and configure the flow to execute weekly.
Build a Data 360-triggered flow on the high-value customer data model object (DMO) and configure a Scheduled Path to execute weekly.
questions.e: Un audience flow con origen de datos Segment, programado semanalmente, es la forma nativa de automatizar el envío a un segmento de Data 360.

questions.q: A Marketing Cloud Next Consultant is designing a new marketing initiative. The design includes three automated, multi-step email sequences, each triggered by different customer actions. All three sequences are part of a single, overarching product launch effort. The consultant needs to organize these automations logically within Marketing Cloud Next. How should the consultant structure the campaigns and flows?
o: Create three campaigns, each with its own related flow.
Create one flow that relates to three separate campaigns.
Create one campaign that relates to three separate flows.
questions.e: La campaña es el contenedor lógico de la iniciativa; los tres recorridos automatizados son tres flujos relacionados con esa única campaña.

questions.q: A Marketing Cloud Next Consultant needs to track the number of emails and SMS messages sent and determine how many credits remain in their entitlement. How should the consultant find this information?
o: Review the Consumption Cards in Digital Wallet.
Navigate to Usage-Based Entitlements in Setup.
Build a custom report using the Data 360 harmonization logs.
questions.e: Las Consumption Cards del Digital Wallet muestran el consumo de envíos y los créditos restantes del entitlement.

questions.q: Which required fields should a Marketing Cloud Next Consultant configure in Data Graphs for personalization in email and SMS?
o: Individual ID from 'Individual' object, Email Address from 'Contact Point Email' object, Telephone Number from 'Contact Point Phone' object
Unified Individual ID from 'Unified Individual' object, Email Address from 'Individual' object, Telephone Number from 'Individual Object'
Unified Individual Link ID from 'Unified Individual Link' object, Email Address from 'Contact Point Email' object, Telephone Number from 'Contact Point Phone' object
questions.e: Los Data Graphs para personalización requieren Individual ID de Individual, Email Address de Contact Point Email y Telephone Number de Contact Point Phone.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters is designing its consent management framework using the standard Data 360 data model. Which data model object (DMO) represents a category or purpose of communication that individuals can subscribe to or unsubscribe from?
o: Communication Subscription Consent
Communication Subscription Channel Type
Communication Subscription
questions.e: El DMO Communication Subscription representa la categoría o propósito de comunicación a la que un individuo se suscribe o de la que se da de baja.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters (NTO) wants to launch a new campaign and needs to pull in data from a newly-mapped custom object. NTO already has a primary Data Graph that is actively being used by several production campaigns, and needs to decide if they should edit or clone the existing Data Graph. What is the correct approach and expected behavior?
o: Edit the Data Graph. The platform will continue to support the live campaigns using the current version without interruption, while the updated version publishes in the background.
Clone the Data Graph. Editing an active Data Graph immediately invalidates downstream dependencies, causing the live segments to fail until the Data Graph finishes reprocessing.
Create a new Data Graph. Pause all active segments and flows relying on the Data Graph, update the Data Graph, and then reactivate the segments and flows.
questions.e: Los Data Graphs se pueden editar en caliente: la versión actual sigue sirviendo a las campañas mientras la nueva se publica en segundo plano.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters wants to build a promotional email. The email must display a personalized subject line based on the recipient's preferred language (stored as a field on the Contact), and show a dynamically repeated list of recommended products from a related custom data model object (DMO). The audience is a segment of Unified Individuals. Which combination of personalization features should the Marketing Cloud Next Consultant configure?
o: Use a variation for the subject line, and a Repeater block linked to the Data Graph for the product list.
Use a content variation on the email for each language, and an AMPscript reading from a marketing object for the product list.
Use a merge field from the Data Graph for the subject line, and a Repeater block linked to the Data Graph for the product list.
questions.e: La variación cubre el subject line por idioma y el bloque Repeater vinculado al Data Graph renderiza la lista dinámica de productos.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters (NTO) wants to send an immediate SMS message with a white paper link to anyone who submits a lead form on the company website. NTO needs to automate this response based on the real-time submission. Which flow type should the Marketing Cloud Next Consultant configure to meet this requirement?
o: Activation-triggered
Automation event-triggered
Record-triggered
questions.e: El envío inmediato al crearse un registro de lead en la plataforma se automatiza con un flujo record-triggered.

questions.q: A Marketing Cloud Next Consultant is configuring an Audience Flow for a personalized email campaign. The campaign must target a specific group of existing Contacts, without using a Data 360 segment. The email must include each recipient's first name and account name. What should the consultant recommend?
o: Upload a CSV file to marketing objects and reference the records using AMPscript in the email for personalization.
Use the Data Graph as the entry source of the Audience Flow, and leverage merge fields to personalize the email.
Create an Actionable List populated from a Contact list view or CSV import, and use Content Variables for email personalization.
questions.e: Sin segmento de Data 360, la Actionable List (desde list view o CSV) alimenta el audience flow y se personaliza con Content Variables.

questions.q: A Marketing Cloud Next Consultant is troubleshooting a flow that sends personalized emails. They want to view engagement metrics of each Send Email Message element within the flow. How should the consultant accomplish this?
o: Open the Analytics tab for each flow element.
Debug the flow in Flow Builder.
Review the Flow Interview logs in Setup.
questions.e: Cada elemento Send Email Message dispone de su propia pestaña Analytics con las métricas de engagement.

questions.q: A retailer is planning their first "New Product Promotion" email campaign in Marketing Cloud Next. Their marketing manager wants to send to everyone in the CRM database who has not explicitly asked to be removed. What will happen when they launch the campaign?
o: The campaign will only suppress recipients who have previously unsubscribed, as explicit consent is not required in sending marketing campaigns in Marketing Cloud Next.

The campaign will suppress all recipients who do not have an OPT_IN record in either the cache or the Communication Subscription Consent data model object (DMO) for the "New Product Promotion" subscription.

The campaign will send successfully because no OPT_OUT record exists in either the cache or the Communication Subscription Consent data model object (DMO) for the "New Product Promotion" subscription.
questions.e: Marketing Cloud Next exige consentimiento explícito: se suprime a quien no tenga registro OPT_IN para esa suscripción.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters (NTO) wants to design an event registration experience in Marketing Cloud Next. NTO asks for a call-to-action (CTA) button in an email that sends visitors to the registration form. How should the Marketing Cloud Next Consultant create the registration form?
o: Publish the form as standalone content and set the CTA link to open the form URL.
Copy the form code snippet and add it to an HTML component in the email.
Add the form component to a landing page and set the CTA link to open the landing page URL.
questions.e: El formulario se publica en una landing page y el CTA del email apunta a la URL de esa landing page.

questions.q: A Marketing Cloud Next Consultant needs to suppress subscribers from an upcoming audience flow who have a low probability of opening or clicking email content. Which Einstein feature should the consultant use?
o: Engagement Scoring
Send Time Optimization
Messaging Insights
questions.e: Engagement Scoring predice la probabilidad de apertura/clic y permite suprimir a los de baja probabilidad.

questions.q: A car dealership manages both retail consumers (B2C) and business fleet customers (B2B). Customer data for each audience is ingested through separate data streams in a single data space and mapped to the Individual Data Model Object (DMO). The dealership wants to create separate identity resolution rulesets for B2B and B2C customers so that each audience can be unified independently for segmentation and activation. Which approach should the Marketing Cloud Next Consultant recommend to ensure B2B and B2C customers are processed by separate identity resolution rulesets?
o: Configure separate DMOs for B2B and B2C customers instead of mapping both to the Individual DMO.
Configure filters on each identity resolution ruleset to separate B2B and B2C customer records.
Configure filters on the source Data Lake Objects (DLOs) to separate B2B and B2C customer records.
questions.e: Con ambos públicos mapeados al mismo DMO Individual, la separación se logra aplicando filtros en cada ruleset de identity resolution.

questions.q: A Marketing Cloud Next Consultant needs to create a re-engagement campaign targeting customers who have not made a purchase in the last 90 days. The campaign will be orchestrated using a flow. The audience for this campaign must be updated automatically as customer purchase behavior changes over time. Which feature must the consultant configure in Data 360 to meet this requirement?
o: Automation Event-Triggered Flow
Audience Flow
Marketing Object
questions.e: El Audience Flow sobre un segmento dinámico mantiene la audiencia actualizada automáticamente conforme cambia el comportamiento de compra.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters collects customer data from multiple sources. Analysis shows that the First Name field is most consistently and accurately populated in the Salesforce CRM data source, while data from other systems is less reliable. When creating a Unified Individual profile, the Marketing Cloud Next Consultant must ensure the first name from the CRM is always used if available. Which reconciliation rule should the consultant use?
o: Custom Reconciliation
Source Sequence
Most Frequent
questions.e: Source Sequence prioriza una fuente concreta (CRM) sobre las demás al reconciliar el valor del atributo.

questions.q: The marketing team at Northern Trail Outfitters wants to create marketing objects to store campaign-related data used for content personalization across different campaigns. Before designing the data model, the team needs to understand the available field types for marketing objects. Which data types are supported when creating marketing objects in Marketing Cloud Next?
o: Text, Number, and Decimal
Text, Formula, and Decimal
String, Integer, and Boolean
questions.e: Los marketing objects admiten campos de tipo Text, Number y Decimal.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters wants to send a personalized one-time verification code immediately after a customer initiates a login on its website. An external web service generates the code and must pass it to Marketing Cloud Next at send time. Which solution should the Marketing Cloud Next Consultant recommend?
o: Create an automation event-triggered flow that waits for the verification code to be ingested through streaming ingestion and uses a Send Email Message element to send the email.
Create a Data 360-triggered flow that retrieves the verification code from a real-time Data Graph and uses a Send Email Message element to send the email.
Create an on-demand flow invoked through the REST API that includes the verification code in the API request and uses a Send Email Message element to send the email.
questions.e: Solo un flujo on-demand invocado por REST API puede recibir el código de verificación en la propia petición y usarlo en el envío.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters wants to send a post-purchase follow-up message via WhatsApp. The message must include the Order Number from the purchase that triggered the send. Which data source type should a Marketing Cloud Next Consultant configure to include the Order Number in the WhatsApp message?
o: Data Graph
Salesforce Record
Event
questions.e: El número de pedido viene del evento que dispara el envío, por lo que el data source correcto es Event.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters needs to send a highly personalized SMS message to customers. The personalization logic requires a complex, real-time calculation based on external system data that is not stored in Data 360. The logic must be executed at the time of send to ensure the data is current. Which data source should a Marketing Cloud Next Consultant use to meet this requirement?
o: Data Graph
Event
Apex Class
questions.e: Un cálculo complejo en tiempo real sobre datos externos no almacenados en Data 360 se resuelve con una Apex Class como data source.

questions.q: A Marketing Cloud Next Consultant needs to give Northern Trail Outfitters a view of standard email key performance indicators (KPIs), such as open rate, click rate, and bounce rate across all email sends, filterable by date range and email message. Which easy to use dashboard should the consultant use?
o: Campaign Performance
Email Engagement
Unified Engagement History
questions.e: El dashboard Email Engagement ofrece los KPIs estándar de email filtrables por fecha y mensaje.

questions.q: A customer has an existing Consent Management Platform (CMP) that manages cookie consent across all external web properties. A Marketing Cloud Next Consultant needs to extend this functionality to the customer's landing pages without showing a duplicate consent banner. How should the consultant configure this?
o: Enable the Data 360 Web Tracking Consent Banner on the landing pages only, and configure the CMP to sync consent decisions via a server-side API call.
Disable the native Data 360 consent banner, and configure the CMP to deploy the Marketing Cloud Next web tracking embed code when a visitor grants consent.
Enable the Data 360 Web Tracking Consent Banner in the Experience Cloud site Integrations, and suppress the CMP banner on landing pages using a custom CSS rule.
questions.e: Se desactiva el banner nativo de Data 360 y es el CMP quien despliega el código de web tracking cuando el visitante acepta.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters (NTO) is configuring a sending domain in Unified Messaging Setup, so that it can send branded emails from its own domain. Which type of domain should NTO use to enable branded email delivery?
o: Authenticated domain, verified with DKIM DNS records
Tracking domain, verified with a bounce CNAME record
Authorized domain, verified with an ownership TXT record
questions.e: El envío de marca desde dominio propio requiere un authenticated domain verificado con registros DKIM.

questions.q: The marketing team at Northern Trail Outfitters needs to deploy a large group of new audience segments next week. To prevent an unexpected credit spike in their Digital Wallet, which configuration settings should the team check and adjust to make sure the segments run efficiently before any data processing begins?
o: Real-Time Data Graph association, Broadcast Flow activation, and Storage Allocation limits
Segment on Entity, Include or Exclude criteria, and Rank or Limit rules
Run Mode, Frequency, Ends, and Lookback Window
questions.e: Run Mode, Frequency, Ends y Lookback Window son los ajustes del segmento que determinan cuánto procesamiento (y crédito) consume.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters (NTO) wants to send a personalized SMS notification to every passenger on a flight whenever the flight itinerary changes. The notification will be initiated by an external system using a single API request. Which flow type should NTO use to start the flow?
o: An on-demand flow where passengers affected by the itinerary change are included in the request
A broadcast flow that uses a dynamic segment to identify passengers affected by the itinerary change
An autolaunched flow that processes the affected passenger records before sending notifications
questions.e: Un flujo on-demand permite que el sistema externo incluya en una única petición API a los pasajeros afectados.

questions.q: A Marketing Cloud Next Consultant wants to create a single, consistent profile for each customer by linking records from various sources like CRM, ecommerce, and loyalty systems. To achieve this, the consultant must create a process to group matching records based on shared identifiers. Which component must the consultant configure in Data 360?
o: Data Graph
Identity Resolution ruleset
Audience Flow
questions.e: El identity resolution ruleset define las reglas de match que agrupan registros de distintas fuentes en un perfil unificado.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters wants its sales team to review each contact's email, form, and page-view engagement directly on the contact record page. How should the Marketing Cloud Next Consultant surface this marketing engagement data?
o: Install the analytics packages and add the Email Engagement dashboard to the contact record page.
Turn on the Unified Engagement History dashboard and add the component to the contact record page.
Enable web tracking and add the Website Engagement data model object (DMO) component to the contact record page.
questions.e: El dashboard Unified Engagement History se activa y se añade como componente a la página de contacto.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters needs to send a one-time promotional email to a specific, fixed group of individuals who registered at a recent trade show. The attendees have been imported into Marketing Cloud Next. Which Data 360 feature is the most appropriate choice for this use case?
o: Actionable List
Segment
Marketing Object
questions.e: Para un grupo fijo y puntual ya importado, la Actionable List es la opción adecuada frente a un segmento dinámico.

questions.q: A Marketing Cloud Next Consultant wants to automate opt-in consent creation when new contacts are added to Salesforce. What should the consultant use to ensure consent records are created and updated reliably?
o: A record-triggered flow using the MessagingConsentV2 core action that is configured to run on both create and update
A direct insert into the Messaging Consent data lake object (DLO) that is mapped to the Communication Subscription Consent data model object (DMO)
A Data 360-triggered flow using the standard Create Consent action that is triggered on the Contact Point Email data model object (DMO)
questions.e: La acción core MessagingConsentV2 en un flujo record-triggered sobre create y update es la vía soportada para crear y mantener el consentimiento de forma fiable.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters would like customers to choose whether they receive product updates by email or SMS for a given subscription, like newsletters or events. Which data model object (DMO) stores the customer's consent status for each subscription and channel?
o: Contact Point Consent
Communication Subscription
Communication Subscription Consent
questions.e: Communication Subscription Consent guarda el estado de consentimiento por suscripción y canal; Communication Subscription solo define la suscripción.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters (NTO) wants to send a monthly update email that includes the total number of items each customer has purchased to date, as well as that customer's favorite category. NTO wants to include fields such as 'Total Items' and 'Category Name' in the email, but these fields do not exist within the raw ecommerce order data, which is currently ingested and mapped in Data 360. How should NTO resolve this issue?
o: Build a streaming insight to calculate this metric in real time. Query the purchase volume per category to find the favorite category for each Unified Individual ID.
Build a calculated insight to aggregate the purchase volume for the account. Query the purchase volume per category to find the favorite category for each Unified Individual ID.
Build a custom formula field on the Unified Individual data model object (DMO) using standard SQL aggregate functions to roll up the total items and calculate the favorite category.
questions.e: Un calculated insight agrega el volumen de compra y permite derivar totales y la categoría favorita por Unified Individual ID.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters (NTO) wants to use an activation-triggered flow to send a personalized email to a group of customers after they qualify for a segment. Which Activation Target type should NTO configure for the flow?
o: Data 360
Segment
Loyalty
questions.e: El Activation Target de un flujo activation-triggered es Data 360, que es quien publica la activación del segmento.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters ingests customer records from its commerce and loyalty systems into Data 360. The records represent the same customer but have different source identifiers. How does Identity Resolution determine that these records belong to the same Unified Individual?
o: It merges the source records into a single Individual record based on survivorship rules.
It applies reconciliation rules to match records and determine the preferred attribute values.
It applies match rules to compare profile attributes and identify Individual records that should be unified.
questions.e: Identity Resolution usa match rules para comparar atributos y decidir qué registros Individual se unifican (las reconciliation rules solo eligen el valor ganador).

questions.q: In addition to Marketing Cloud Admin, which permission set is required to enable Marketing Performance in Marketing Cloud Next?
o: Data 360 Activation Manager
Tableau Next Included App Business User
Data 360 Architect
questions.e: Marketing Performance se apoya en Tableau Next, por lo que hace falta el permission set Tableau Next Included App Business User.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters wants to send a personalized email immediately after a customer submits a product recommendation form on a landing page. The email must include the customer's first name and the product category selected on the form. Which personalization approach should a Marketing Cloud Next Consultant recommend?
o: Create a marketing object and reference the submitted form values from the email.
Select a Data Graph Data Provider that retrieves the submitted form values from a Real-Time Data Graph.
Configure an Event Data Provider in the email and reference the submitted form values as merge fields.
questions.e: Los valores del formulario llegan como evento en tiempo real: se configura un Event Data Provider y se referencian como merge fields.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters (NTO) wants to include a list of purchased products in an order confirmation email. The order includes the product name, image URL, and price for each item in the order. How should NTO display all of the purchased products in the email?
o: Create variations in the email for each product and configure targeting rules based on the order data.
Add a Repeater component to the email and configure the Repeater Source to use the order data.
Use AMPscript to retrieve the order data as a rowset and loop through the records to render each product.
questions.e: El componente Repeater con el Repeater Source apuntando a los datos del pedido renderiza la lista completa de productos.

questions.q: A contact calls a service rep and asks to be opted out of all marketing emails. What is the correct supported action to opt-out the contact?
o: Update the consent via the Consent Status flow element.
Update the consent on the contact's preference page.
Update the Opt Out field on the Contact record.
questions.e: El elemento de flujo Consent Status es la acción soportada para actualizar el consentimiento; el campo Opt Out del Contact no gobierna este modelo.

questions.q: A marketing team attended a trade show and collected details of attendees who consented to receive marketing communications. The team needs to send a one-time welcome email to these individuals. Which method should the team use to ingest and target this collection of attendees?
o: Create a new marketing object.
Import the data as an Actionable List.
Build a static Segment with a filter.
questions.e: Un grupo fijo y puntual de asistentes se ingesta y se activa como Actionable List.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters wants to see the engagement activity data of its Unified Individuals on lead and contact records. Which component should a Marketing Cloud Next Consultant add to the lead and contact page layouts to achieve this?
o: Unified Engagement History Dashboard
Data 360 Profile Related Records
Individual Email Results
questions.e: El componente Unified Engagement History Dashboard muestra la actividad de engagement del Unified Individual en lead y contact.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters runs an identity resolution ruleset that consolidates two individual records into a single Unified Individual profile. One individual record includes a personal email address, while the other contains a work email address. Both email addresses are associated with the same Unified Individual profile. When an Audience Flow uses this Unified Individual to send an email to segment members, what happens by default?
o: One email is sent to the address designated as the primary Contact Point Email for the Unified Individual.
One email is sent to the address selected by the identity resolution reconciliation rule.
Two emails are sent, one to each email address associated with the Unified Individual.
questions.note: El documento original dejó esta respuesta en blanco. Por defecto, sin una Contact Point Selection Rule / plantilla de activación, la activación envía a todos los contact points válidos del individuo unificado.
questions.e: Sin una regla de selección de contact point o plantilla de activación, la activación envía a cada contact point de email válido del individuo unificado, por lo que se enviarían dos correos.

questions.q: A Marketing Cloud Next Consultant is using Agentforce to generate a conversational email campaign. After reviewing the campaign preview, they notice an extra step in the underlying campaign flow labeled 'Forward to Agent.' What is the function of this specific flow step?
o: It specifies how to handle the email response from the customer.
It sends a notification to the marketing manager to review the flow.
It pauses the campaign to wait for agent approval before sending.
questions.e: El paso 'Forward to Agent' define cómo se gestiona la respuesta del cliente al email, enviándola al agente.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters just wrapped up its holiday campaign, which included several "gift-finder" forms that visitors could fill out on the website. The marketing manager wants a high-level overview of how all the forms performed, and needs to be able to filter the view by date and public title. Where should they go to find this information?
o: Landing Page Engagement dashboard
Forms Engagement dashboard
Campaign Performance dashboard
questions.e: El dashboard Forms Engagement da la visión agregada del rendimiento de los formularios, filtrable por fecha y título público.

questions.q: A Marketing Cloud Next Consultant is provisioning a new Marketing Cloud Next Environment. When the consultant clicks "Deploy" for the Sales Data Kit in the Setup Assistant, the deployment fails. What is the most likely cause?
o: The org does not have an active Identity Resolution ruleset running for the Individual object.
The consultant needs to create a CRM Connector within Data 360 before the guided deployment can complete.
The consultant lacks the required profile and permission sets.
questions.e: El despliegue del Sales Data Kit requiere el CRM Connector configurado previamente en Data 360.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters has created a new Business Unit in Marketing Cloud Next for its EMEA marketing team. An administrator needs to grant existing users access. Which permission set must the administrator have to add users to the new Business Unit?
o: Marketing Cloud Admin
System Administrator
Business Unit Admin
questions.e: Añadir usuarios a una Business Unit requiere el permission set Marketing Cloud Admin.

questions.q: A Marketing Cloud Next Consultant needs to ingest tabular data for marketing use cases. Which feature should the consultant use?
o: File Upload Data Stream
Actionable List
Marketing Object
questions.e: Los marketing objects son la función para ingestar datos tabulares destinados a casos de uso de marketing.

questions.q: A Marketing Cloud Next Consultant uses the Campaign Creation Agent to generate a campaign brief, flow, and email assets from a single prompt. They now need a matching audience segment without rewriting the audience description. How should the consultant generate the segment so it reflects the campaign brief?
o: Create a new segment, choose Segment Creation, and describe the Segment.
Ask the Campaign Creation Agent in the Agentforce chat to build the segment during campaign creation.
Open the segment builder from the Campaign, choose Segment Creation, and review the generated Segment draft.
questions.e: Desde la campaña se abre el segment builder, se elige Segment Creation y se revisa el borrador generado a partir del brief.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters has multiple data sources feeding into Data 360, including a Salesforce CRM and a third-party event registration system. The data from the CRM is considered the most reliable when conflicts arise in a unified profile. Which reconciliation rule must the Marketing Cloud Next Consultant use to meet this business requirement?
o: Most Frequent
Source Priority
Last Updated
questions.e: Source Priority indica qué fuente prevalece cuando hay conflicto de valores en el perfil unificado.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters (NTO) is preparing customer data for personalization within its newly set up Marketing Cloud Next org. NTO wants to ensure that related data is connected and accessible to send to Unified Individuals for marketing campaigns. Which Data 360 feature should a Marketing Cloud Next Consultant configure to enable personalization?
o: Calculated Insights
Custom marketing objects
Data Graph for the Data Model Objects (DMOs)
questions.e: El Data Graph conecta y aplana los DMOs relacionados para que la personalización pueda consumirlos.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters (NTO) wants to use dynamic reply addresses. A Marketing Cloud Next Consultant advises NTO that it needs to have the domain authorized. The consultant adds the domain into the "Authorized Email Domains" list. What is the next step to complete the verification process?
o: Create an Authenticated From Address using the domain.
Assign the domain to a Sender Authentication Package.
Confirm domain ownership by adding a generated TXT record to the DNS.
questions.e: Los dominios autorizados se verifican demostrando la propiedad con un registro TXT en el DNS.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters creates a communication subscription named "Product Announcements" and associates it with both the Email and SMS channels. When reviewing the Communication Subscription Channel Type data model object (DMO), a developer finds two records for the subscription. How should a Marketing Cloud Next Consultant explain why two records were created?
o: The DMO creates one record for each contact point associated with the subscription.
The DMO creates separate records for the subscription's Opt In and Opt Out consent statuses.
The DMO creates a separate record for each communication subscription and channel combination.
questions.e: El DMO Communication Subscription Channel Type crea un registro por cada combinación de suscripción y canal (Email y SMS = 2 registros).

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters wants website visitors to be able to register for an upcoming event on a landing page. When a visitor submits the registration form, a Lead record should be created in CRM. Which set of components should a Marketing Cloud Next Consultant configure to support this use case?
o: Landing page, form handler, and data stream
Landing page, form, and flow
Web-to-lead form, data stream, and flow
questions.e: Landing page + form + flow: el flujo es quien crea el registro de Lead en CRM tras el envío del formulario.

questions.q: A marketer at Northern Trail Outfitters wants to personalize an email by displaying a customer's loyalty status and points, which requires conditional logic. The data is available via the Data Graph. Which personalization method should the company use to meet this requirement?
o: Merge fields
Handlebars
Dynamic content blocks
questions.e: La lógica condicional dentro del contenido se resuelve con Handlebars, no con merge fields simples.

questions.q: A retailer wants to create a new "Weekly Deals" subscription to send promotional content to customers via email and SMS. Which two data model objects (DMOs) in Data 360 are used to define the subscription and map it to communication channels?
o: Communication Subscription Channel Type and Engagement Channel Type
Communication Subscription and Communication Subscription Consent
Communication Subscription and Communication Subscription Channel Type
questions.e: Communication Subscription define la suscripción y Communication Subscription Channel Type la mapea a los canales.

questions.q: A Marketing Cloud Next Consultant has created a 'Lapsed Customer' segment in Data 360 for customers who have not made a purchase in the last 90 days. They want to automatically send a re-engagement email followed by an SMS offer to anyone who enters this segment. Which automation tool should the consultant use to build this campaign?
o: Audience flow
Event-triggered flow
Automation event-triggered flow
questions.e: La entrada en un segmento se orquesta con un audience flow, que admite pasos multicanal (email y luego SMS).

questions.q: The marketing team at Northern Trail Outfitters wants customers to reply directly to promotional emails and receive AI-generated responses that can answer product questions, recommend products, and escalate complex inquiries to a human agent when necessary. Which set of implementation activities is required to enable Conversational Email in Marketing Cloud Next?
o: Configure escalation experience • Configure a transactional messaging API endpoint • Configure Conversational Email • Create a conversational email campaign • Configure Salesforce Flow for Service
Configure Reply Mail Management • Create a data stream • Create a conversational email campaign • Enable Journey Builder event processing • Configure Marketing Cloud Connect
Configure escalation experience • Set up Service Agents • Configure Conversational Email • Create a conversational email campaign • Monitor engagement and routing outcomes
questions.e: Conversational Email requiere configurar la experiencia de escalado, Service Agents, Conversational Email, la campaña y monitorizar routing/engagement.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters sends a promotional email weekly. The audience segment refreshes daily, although the source data is updated only once a week. Data 360 credit consumption is higher than expected. What should a Marketing Cloud Next Consultant recommend?
o: Change the segment run mode to Do Not Schedule and configure the flow to republish the segment immediately before running the flow.
Configure an activation filter to include only records updated during the previous week while retaining the segment's refresh schedule.
Change the segment to a streaming segment so that membership is continuously updated before the weekly flow runs.
questions.e: Si el dato origen solo cambia semanalmente, se pone el segmento en Do Not Schedule y se republica desde el flujo justo antes del envío.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters must send a transactional email immediately after a customer places an order. Its commerce system will initiate the send through an API request. Which solution should a Marketing Cloud Next Consultant recommend?
o: Use the REST API to invoke an on-demand flow.
Use the Data 360 Ingestion API to invoke an automation event-triggered flow.
Use the REST API to invoke a triggered send email definition.
questions.e: El envío transaccional iniciado por un sistema externo mediante API se resuelve con un flujo on-demand invocado por REST API.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters needs to update an individual's consent in near real time when a customer submits a web form. Which solution should the Marketing Cloud Next Consultant recommend?
o: Create an automation event-triggered flow that includes a Consent Request Flow element to update the customer's consent preferences.
Use the Data 360 Ingestion API to ingest records into a data stream and map to the Subscription Consent Data Model Object (DMO).
Create a streaming data transform to map incoming form submissions to the Communication Subscription Consent Data Model Object (DMO).
questions.e: Un flujo automation event-triggered con el elemento Consent Request Flow actualiza el consentimiento casi en tiempo real.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters (NTO) wants to track visitor activity on landing pages. To comply with privacy regulations, NTO plans to display a consent banner before enabling tracking. What is the first step NTO should take to create a consent banner?
o: Create a new CMS content block and assign it as the consent banner to use on landing pages.
Create a new landing page and enable the 'Display Consent Banner' option in the page settings.
Create a new CMS content item using the 'Consent Banner' content type.
questions.e: El banner de consentimiento se crea como content item de CMS usando el content type 'Consent Banner'.

questions.q: A marketing manager wants to launch a new campaign targeting customers who have recently browsed winter boots but have not purchased. The manager is not an expert in data structures or SQL. They need a way to translate this business requirement into a functional audience segment without technical assistance. Which Marketing Cloud Next capability should the manager use for this task?
o: Quick Filter for recent browsing activity
AI-Assisted Segment Creation
Segment rules using AND/OR logic
questions.e: AI-Assisted Segment Creation traduce el requisito de negocio en lenguaje natural a un segmento funcional sin SQL.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters (NTO) wants to personalize an email's subject line with a value that is entered at the time of campaign activation, such as 'Exclusive Offer for Hikers'. Which data source should NTO use for the subject line?
o: Activation
Data Graph
Content Variable
questions.e: Un valor introducido en el momento de la activación se referencia con el data source Activation.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters is implementing Marketing Cloud Next and wants to use a branded domain for email sending. Which steps are required to configure the branded email sending domain?
o: Add the domain from Authorized Email Domains in Setup, and then create the required DNS records with the organization's DNS provider.
Add the domain from Authenticated Domains in Setup, and then create the required DNS records with the organization's DNS provider.
Retrieve the DNS records from Sender Authentication Package in Setup, and then create the required DNS records with the organization's DNS provider.
questions.e: El dominio de envío de marca se añade desde Authenticated Domains en Setup y luego se publican los registros DNS generados.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters contracts a London agency to create assets and deploy email campaigns exclusively for the EMEA region, which is managed in a dedicated EMEA Business Unit. The agency users have been provisioned with the Marketing Cloud Manager permission set. How should the Marketing Cloud Next Consultant grant the agency users the required access?
o: Add the agency users to the EMEA Business Unit with the Marketer ReadOnly role.
Add the agency users to the EMEA Data Space with the Data 360 Marketing Manager permission set.
Add the agency users to the EMEA Business Unit with the Marketer Standard role.
questions.e: El acceso de la agencia se concede añadiéndola a la BU EMEA con el rol Marketer Standard, que permite crear y desplegar.

questions.q: The marketing team at Northern Trail Outfitters wants to understand the company's email performance (open rates, click rates, unsubscribes). Which easy to use dashboard should the Marketing Cloud Next Consultant recommend?
o: Email Engagement
Flow Analytics
Content Performance
questions.e: El dashboard Email Engagement cubre aperturas, clics y bajas.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters receives a high volume of support cases from customers requesting tracking updates on their orders. These low-value cases are taking up too much of the support team's time. Which solution should a Marketing Cloud Next Consultant implement to autonomously resolve this situation?
o: Embed a link in each email to the Tracking page that contains a Support AI agent chatbot.
Create a flow to enable support tickets related to "Where is my order" to be routed to an AI agent.
Enable Conversational Email on the Order Confirmation and Tracking emails to route the inbound requests to an AI agent.
questions.e: Conversational Email en los emails de confirmación y seguimiento permite que un agente de IA resuelva las consultas entrantes de forma autónoma.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters is launching a global promotional campaign using an audience flow. To maximize engagement, the Marketing Cloud Next Consultant needs to ensure the flow delivers the email to each subscriber at the optimal time. Which Einstein feature should the consultant use?
o: Engagement Scoring
Send Time Optimization
Messaging Insights
questions.e: Send Time Optimization determina la hora óptima de entrega para cada suscriptor.

questions.q: How does Marketing Cloud Next evaluate consent when determining whether a marketing message can be sent to a customer?
o: Consent applies to a specific contact point, channel, and subscription.
Consent applies to a specific contact point and is shared across all subscriptions.
Consent applies to an individual, regardless of the channel, subscription, or contact point.
questions.e: El consentimiento se evalúa por la combinación de contact point, canal y suscripción.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters wants to enrich its customer profiles by combining CRM Contact data with anonymous web browsing activity captured via the web tracking embed code. A Marketing Cloud Next Consultant has already set up the Contact data stream mapped to the Individual data model object (DMO) and confirmed that web tracking events are flowing into the Website Engagement DMO. What must the consultant configure in Identity Resolution to link anonymous visitor data to known Contact profiles?
o: Create a Data 360-triggered flow on the Website Engagement DMO to look up the matching Individual record and update the Identity Match DMO with the visitor's email address.
Add a matching rule based on contact point email between the Website Engagement DMO and the Individual DMO, so that form submissions are matched to known Contacts.
Add a custom rule in the identity resolution ruleset to include the Identity Match DMO using the device-to-known record type, so that anonymous visitor IDs are stitched to known Individual IDs.
questions.e: Se añade una regla personalizada al ruleset con el DMO Identity Match y el record type device-to-known para coser IDs anónimos con individuos conocidos.

questions.q: A marketing manager needs to send a one-time personalized email that includes localized product names, descriptions, and image URLs. This information is stored in a CSV file and is not available in Data 360 or CRM. What should a Marketing Cloud Next Consultant recommend?
o: Upload the CSV file to a Marketing object to be used as a data source.
Upload the CSV file into a CRM custom object and ingest into a data stream.
Upload the CSV file as a new data stream and map the fields to a data model object.
questions.e: Los datos de un CSV puntual que no existen en Data 360 ni en CRM se cargan a un marketing object y se usan como data source.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters is implementing identity resolution in Data 360 and wants to understand how subsequent runs affect credit consumption. Which records does Data 360 process during each subsequent identity resolution run?
o: Only records that were created after the previous run
All source records in the data space
Only records that are new or have changed since the previous run
questions.e: Las ejecuciones posteriores de identity resolution procesan solo los registros nuevos o modificados desde la ejecución anterior.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters (NTO) needs to export a list of all the individuals who clicked on a link in its 'Back to School' campaign along with email and phone number. Which approach should NTO use to accomplish this?
o: Click the Analytics tab and build a report using the Marketing Performance Semantic Model report type.
Navigate to the Campaign tab and export the data directly from the dashboard on the Campaign record.
Open the Marketing Performance tab and filter for the 'Back to School' campaign to view and export individual-level engagement data.
questions.e: El report type del Marketing Performance Semantic Model permite construir y exportar el detalle individual de clics con email y teléfono.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters wants to automatically send a customer satisfaction survey email after a Case record in CRM is updated to a status of "Closed". Which flow type should a Marketing Cloud Next Consultant use to support this near real-time use case?
o: An audience flow that uses a Record audience source based on the Case object, where the audience source is configured to include only Case records that meet condition requirements for the defined criteria

A record-triggered flow that runs when a Case record is updated and meets the specified entry criteria, where the flow configuration is optimized for "Actions and Related Records" so it executes after the record is saved
An automation event-triggered flow that uses a "Prospect, Lead, Contact, or Related Record Change" event which is based on the Case object and meets condition requirements for the defined criteria
questions.e: El evento 'Prospect, Lead, Contact, or Related Record Change' sobre Case en un flujo automation event-triggered es el patrón nativo para reaccionar casi en tiempo real.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters is building an activation-triggered flow to send promotional emails. The marketing team needs to personalize the email content using data derived from the activation, such as a calculated loyalty tier. Which data provider should the company use to personalize the email?
o: Activation
Data Graph
Apex Class
questions.e: Los datos derivados de la activación (como un tier calculado) se exponen con el data provider Activation.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters is launching a Conversational Email campaign and needs to ensure that when a customer replies to the promotional email, Agentforce immediately picks up the thread to answer product questions. How should the Marketing Cloud Next Consultant configure the flow to route these inbound replies to assign the conversation?
o: Create a record-triggered flow that triggers on Email Message.
Create an Omni-Channel flow that triggers on Inbound Message.
Create a platform event-triggered flow that triggers on an Inbound Message Event.
questions.e: Las respuestas entrantes se asignan con un flujo de Omni-Channel disparado por Inbound Message.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters wants to reduce customer email fatigue and opt-outs. Which feature should the Marketing Cloud Next Consultant configure to achieve this goal?
o: Engagement Frequency
Send Time Optimization
Messaging Insights
questions.e: Engagement Frequency limita el número de mensajes por individuo y reduce la fatiga y las bajas.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters operates with a central corporate marketing team and regional marketing teams in multiple Business Units. The corporate team creates approved email templates in a central enhanced CMS workspace. The regional teams report that they cannot access these corporate templates for their campaigns. They can only see content created within their own Business Unit's workspace. What is the cause of this issue?
o: The regional users must be added as contributors to the enhanced CMS workspace.
The content in an enhanced CMS workspace is related to its Business Unit by default.
The corporate templates have not been published to the enhanced CMS workspace.
questions.e: El contenido de un enhanced CMS workspace está asociado por defecto a su Business Unit, por eso las regiones no lo ven.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters' sales reps want to see the Overall Marketing Score for leads, contacts, and prospects on the record page. What should the Marketing Cloud Next Consultant do to achieve this?
o: Add a Custom Report based on the Overall Marketing Score to the Page Layout.
Add the Data 360 Profile Insights component to the Page Layout and select the Overall Marketing Score.
Add the Unified Engagement History dashboard component to the Page Layout and select the Overall Marketing Score.
questions.e: El componente Data 360 Profile Insights en el page layout permite mostrar el Overall Marketing Score.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters (NTO) runs a weekly promotional newsletter. NTO's Marketing Cloud Next Consultant has configured a record-triggered flow on the Lead object in Salesforce that fires when a lead clicks a specific product link in an email. The flow is meant to automatically opt the lead in to a product subscription using the Create Consent action, but the consent record consistently fails to create. What should the consultant configure instead?
o: Add a Get Records element before the Create Consent action inside the same record-triggered flow to retrieve the Contact Point Email record, and use its ID as the input for the Create Consent action.
Replace the record-triggered flow with an audience flow using a segment of leads who clicked the product link, and use the Create Consent action inside that flow.

Create a Data 360-triggered flow on the Email Engagement Data Model Object (DMO), filtered on Clicks and the specific product link URL, and use the Send time Email Address field to create the consent record.
questions.e: El clic es un evento de engagement: se usa un flujo Data 360-triggered sobre el DMO Email Engagement filtrado por clic y URL, usando el email de envío para crear el consentimiento.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters configured a segment and its associated audience flow to run daily. Occasionally, the flow runs before the segment refresh is complete, causing it to process outdated segment members. What should a Marketing Cloud Next Consultant recommend?
o: Add a Wait for Amount of Time element to the audience flow at the start of the flow.
Schedule the segment refresh and audience flow to run at the same time each day.
Configure the audience flow to republish the segment immediately before running the flow.
questions.e: Configurar el audience flow para republicar el segmento justo antes de ejecutarse elimina la condición de carrera.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters uses distinct Business Units for each of its shoe lines. The central marketing team needs to provide a set of legally approved brand logos and disclaimers that all marketers, regardless of Business Unit, must use in their emails. The goal is to enforce brand consistency while giving Business Unit marketers the ability to create their own campaigns. Which governance model should the Marketing Cloud Next Consultant recommend to meet this requirement?
o: Assign marketers to a new permission set for access to a central content folder inside the enhanced CMS workspace.
Use a central enhanced CMS workspace and publish approved content to the Common Assets library.
Store the approved assets in one Business Unit's enhanced CMS workspace and grant contributor access to all users.
questions.e: El workspace central de CMS mejorado publicando en la Common Assets library da acceso a todas las BUs manteniendo el control central.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters (NTO) wants to automate a follow-up action for customers who submit a 'Contact Us' form on its website, which is built on the Salesforce Platform. NTO requires that a confirmation SMS is sent instantly to the customer with a link to a resource document. The automation must react in real time to the form submission event. Which type of flow should the Marketing Cloud Next Consultant use to meet this requirement?
o: Audience flow
Schedule-triggered flow
Event-triggered flow
questions.e: La respuesta en tiempo real a un evento de formulario en la plataforma se automatiza con un flujo event-triggered.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters (NTO) wants to send an email campaign to a segment of Unified Individuals. Some Unified Individuals have multiple associated email addresses, and NTO needs to ensure that only one email address is selected for delivery. Which method should a Marketing Cloud Next Consultant use to determine which email address is prioritized for sending?
o: Create a reconciliation rule in the identity resolution ruleset to specify which email contact point should be used for activation.
Configure an Activation Template that defines the preferred email contact point and apply the template when creating the audience flow.
Apply a Rank and Limit rule in the segment to order email contact points by a specified attribute and return only the highest-ranked email address.
questions.e: Una Activation Template define el contact point de email preferido y se aplica al crear el audience flow.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters needs to personalize an email with: • The recipient's assigned sales rep's name (stored in Agentforce Sales) • A unique, time-sensitive promo code (managed in Marketing Cloud Next). Which data sources should the company use for each?
o: Salesforce Record for the sales rep's name and an Offer for the promo code
Apex Class for the sales rep's name and a Data Graph for the promo code
Data Graph for both the sales rep's name and the promo code
questions.e: El nombre del comercial vive en CRM (Salesforce Record) y el código promocional gestionado en Marketing Cloud Next se sirve como Offer.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters (NTO) wants to launch its first Marketing Cloud Next campaign. NTO wants to leverage its robust data to create a highly targeted, personalized experience. Which strategy should NTO take to build its first Data Graph?
o: Build a single comprehensive Data Graph that works with current and future use cases.
Build a single lean Data Graph for static demographic data and a second one for dynamic transactional data.
Build a single lean Data Graph and expand as more campaigns are launched.
questions.e: La buena práctica es empezar con un Data Graph ligero y ampliarlo a medida que se lanzan más campañas.
